notablePrerequisites:
Evil Twin is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Evil Twin do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Evil Twin.
Activate Evil Twin by tapping it.
When Evil Twin becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Evil Twin's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
